hint.description: German hint for the feedback sheet

GhegReplacement.description: suffix: the word before the match + value must begin the Gheg word (which may carry an inflection ending: punuar → punue, punuem, punuemi). prefix: value + the word after the match must equal the Gheg word, also with a j between them if the rest begins with a vowel (shtëpia → shpija). word: value must equal the Gheg word.

errorHints.description: Known wrong answers; the first one whose pattern matches classifies a wrong answer. Typed answers (translate_free, fill_gap without choices) are checked in this order: exact, Standard form, missing diacritics only, Standard form with missing diacritics, errorHints, same words reordered (grammar.word_order), typo, wrong. Picked options: exact, errorHints, wrong. Word tiles: exact, same tokens reordered (grammar.word_order), errorHints, wrong.

StandardFormsResponse.description: The Standard-form lexicon of content/gheg_blocklist.json. All words, values and exceptions are normalised (docs/CONTENT_FORMAT.md points 1–2). A learner's word is the Standard form of the solution's Gheg word if it is a listed standard word with that Gheg word, or if it matches a pattern, is none of its exceptions and one of the pattern's replacements yields the Gheg word. For the comparison with missing diacritics, fold every word, value, exception and the pattern itself (ë→e, ç→c, â→a, ê→e, î→i, ô→o, û→u) before matching.

StandardWord.description: A Standard word and its Gheg alternatives, e.g. qenë → kânë, kjenë

StandardWordPattern.description: Standard words recognised by a regular expression on the single word, e.g. punuar → punue

exceptions.description: Words that match but are no Standard forms

pattern.description: Unicode regular expression, searched (not fully matched) in the normalised word

unitId.description: A curriculum unit or a focus unit of the current plan, as listed by GET /api/path

StartPlacementResponse.description: A started placement test with its first item

maxItems.description: The most items the test can take; it usually ends earlier

SubmittedAnswer.description: Exactly one field, depending on the exercise type: text for translate_free and fill_gap without choices, choice for multiple_choice and fill_gap with choices, tokens for translate_wordbank and word_order, wrongMatches for match_pairs.

mistakes.description: Number of wrong matches; send wrongMatches instead

tokens.description: Word chips in the chosen order

wrongMatches.description: match_pairs: every wrong match before all pairs were matched, in order; empty if none. Each one joins the left side of one pair with the right side of another, as shown.

WrongMatch.description: A Gheg side (left) matched with the German side (right) of another pair

perfectBonus.description: No mistake at the first attempts

speedBonus.description: Median first-attempt response time of at most 8 seconds

get.description: The rules with which the evaluator recognises Standard Albanian words in typed Gheg answers (correct_standard_form, variant.standard_form). An answer is a Standard form if it has as many words as a solution and every word that differs from the solution's word at the same position is a Standard form of it. A second pass after the missing-diacritics check also lets the other words lack diacritics and compares the Standard forms folded. Cacheable for a day.

post.description: The exercises include their solutions, accepted variants and error hints so that the app can pre-check answers instantly (PRD 11.2), together with GET /api/content/standard-forms. A focus unit of the current plan (focus_<skill tag>_<n>) is composed of the exercises carrying its skill tag at or below the learner's level.
